notes.title: The PANTHALASSA Demo is out now!
notes.notes:
The Panthalassa Demo is finally out!

Dive into Panthalassa, A point and click adventure game set in an alien underwater world.
We have also released a new trailer to celebrate this event.

[previewyoutube=8-vLaKxf4EM;full][/previewyoutube]

We have been working hard over the last year to make Panthalassa, It hasnt been easy, what started as a much more humble and small game has slowly been expanding behind the scenes, we have been adding new characters, puzzles and locations and hope to be able to show you more of this game as the year rolls on.

[img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2955720/extras/MAIN_GAMEPLAY.gif?t=1736182560[/img]

This demo is a short slice of what Panthalassa has to offer, showing off some of our main mechanics and puzzles as well as introducing our 2 main characters MAG and Tetra.

[img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2955720/extras/SCOPE_GAMEPLAY-1.gif?t=1736182560[/img]

This is the first time our team releases a game so we are very excited for you to check it out. feel free to send us your opinions and feedback in the steam community or over on our socials

https://linktr.ee/meia_calca
